# Security policy

This repository is Lazurio T3 Code, a modified distribution of T3 Code for Lazurio Environments
(see the [README](README.md)). Report security problems with it privately, here: on this
repository's **Security** tab, choose **Report a vulnerability**. Please do not disclose them
publicly until we have had a reasonable opportunity to investigate and fix them.

A problem in the Lazurio changes is ours to fix, so please don't send it to the T3 Code team. If
it also affects upstream T3 Code, report it to them too, under their policy below.

## Upstream T3 Code

Report security vulnerabilities affecting T3 Code or T3 Tools-operated infrastructure to
[security@ping.gg](mailto:security@ping.gg). Please do not disclose them publicly until we have had
a reasonable opportunity to investigate and remediate them.

See the [full security policy](https://t3.codes/security-policy) for reporting details, scope,
and safe harbor terms for good-faith research.
